'''2011 US Nationals John Anderson LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Moulin Rouges
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
